name: Obligation / Commitment
publication_holds: Live-URL and version-pin verification for all fourteen base sources plus the two imported ones (XACML 3.0, HL7 FHIR obligation codes) before any citation is published.

FIBO source conflict: the base pins spec.edmcouncil.org Agreements and Contracts at 'master/latest retrieved 2026-08-23' while the other provider pins raw.githubusercontent.com at versionIRI 20260601. Resolve to one dated release IRI before publication.

UNIDROIT edition pin: the base cites the 2016 black-letter PDF, while the imported cure and additional-period function derives from a 2010 Chapter 7 Section 1 page. Confirm 2016 numbering for Articles 7.1.1 to 7.1.5 before citing them.

Multi-profile domain validation: exercise the mixin against a contract clause, a statutory or regulatory duty, a court or administrative order, an internal voluntary commitment and an access-control or conformance obligation before claiming the alignment holds.

Performance-standard finding remains partially supported: ISO/IEC 19086-1 returned HTTP 403, so thresholds, metrics and measurement windows must be published as generic structure explicitly labelled as lacking primary grounding.

ISO 37301 normative clause text is paywalled and only the committee scope statement was read; register upkeep, review cadence and escalation must be published as practice, not as cited normative requirements.

Confirm the imported XACML and FHIR sense alignment is published as a crosswalk entry only and does not reopen the base exclusion of access-control decision points and their evaluation infrastructure.
No conformance claim to ODRL, LegalRuleML, FIBO, IFRS 15, XACML or FHIR may be published without a dated validation report; alignment relations only until then.
